groups.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the Markdown contains paired double pipes.
groups.capability: Recognize a spoiler span and render opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
groups.consequence: The new spoiler rendering path is not exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Each describes reachability of the same flagged spoiler rendering operation; differences in certainty about the call path do not change the hypothesis.

groups.operation: Reach a spoiler span through md_html.
groups.condition: Spoiler parsing is enabled and the Markdown contains paired double pipes.
groups.capability: Resolve paired double pipes as a spoiler span.
groups.consequence: The spoiler span cannot be reached through the target operation.
groups.equivalence_reason: Its stated requirement is span reachability; whether it also requires x-spoiler HTML output is uncertain.

groups.operation: Retain HTML chunks emitted by md_html.
groups.condition: The output callback receives rendered HTML.
groups.capability: Store the chunks for later inspection.
groups.consequence: The emitted HTML is unavailable for later inspection.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three state the same proposed output retention requirement and consequence.

groups.operation: Deliver ordinary emphasis HTML through md_html's output callback.
groups.condition: The Markdown contains an emphasis span.
groups.capability: Make the generated emphasis HTML available through the callback.
groups.consequence: The harness discards the ordinary emphasis output.
groups.equivalence_reason: This concerns an older ordinary emphasis operation, distinct from spoiler output.

groups.operation: Deliver spoiler HTML through md_html's output callback.
groups.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the Markdown contains ||text||.
groups.capability: Make the generated <x-spoiler> tags available through the callback.
groups.consequence: The harness discards the spoiler tags.
groups.equivalence_reason: This concerns output delivery after rendering, distinct from reaching spoiler parsing and rendering.

groups.operation: Parse a table cell containing spoiler delimiters.
groups.condition: Table and spoiler parsing are enabled, with double pipes inside a cell and single pipes delimiting cells.
groups.capability: Preserve double pipes for spoiler parsing while treating single pipes as cell boundaries.
groups.consequence: Spoiler delimiters are lost or treated as table boundaries.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same table cell interaction and failure consequence.

groups.operation: Invoke md_html with a short Markdown payload.
groups.condition: The Markdown payload is shorter than eight bytes and follows the harness's eight byte flag prefix.
groups.capability: Pass the short remainder to md_html despite the whole input size guard.
groups.consequence: Short Markdown payloads are not exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate concerns the input size guard or short payloads.
